question: Whom worship in the middle after wheel-rising?
premises: in the middle worship the Kula-mistress
drawing-together, at end's end causing destruction and nourishment
inference: Kulesvari enthroned center after cakrodaya, as Samkarsini.
plain_english: Having worshipped the wheel-rising thus — in the middle worship the Kula-mistress, drawing-together, at end's end causing destruction and nourishment.
